name: offside_2v2_surplus
description: 2v2, the same blue positions, but BOTH orange cars are onside. Blue now has one more car out of position than orange: team factor = clamp((1 - 0) / 1) = 1, so car 0 pays the full -1.0 per step even though a teammate covers.

expect.intent: a surplus car out of position pays in full even with a teammate covering
car 0 is covered, yet still pays: covering no longer exempts a surplus car
the covering teammate, goalside of the ball, pays nothing
